73072.context: Let's take Adam and Eve, for example. The Adam and Eve story in Genesis is often treated as a simple moral parable, but structurally, it functions as a psychological blueprint, one that collapses under scrutiny. There is no evidence for a first human couple, no support from population genetics for humanity descending from two individuals, and no plausible framework in which a talking serpent and a magical tree dispensing moral knowledge makes any sense. These elements are not symbolic add-ons, they are the mechanism of the story.

73072.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)

73073.context: The flood narrative in Genesis represents the clearest collision between mythic storytelling and moral catastrophe. Scientifically, the story collapses on every front. 73073.title: Everything Wrong With Genesis (Because Everything After Depends On It)
